name: Marovitz (Chicago lakefront parkland)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Sydney R. Marovitz, Lincoln Park, Chicago: a 1932 park course on land filled in from Lake Michigan. Cool-season bluegrass/rye turf in a slightly bluer green than pnw; bright white-tan bunker sand; Lake Michigan's clear near-shore teal (the theme's main difference from every other set: the lake fills the east side of the world); rough F0-F2 a cool mid green. Trees in assets-src/trees_marovitz.py: American elm, honey locust and cottonwood, with blue spruce and Austrian pine. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these. Course chat, 2026-10-31.
